question: Which chapter is completed in the work composed by śrī sarvānandanātha?
premises: śrī-sarvānandanātha-viracite means in śrī sarvānandanātha composed
inference: the thirty-second chapter in sarvollāsa composed by śrī sarvānandanātha is completed
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-second chapter in the sarvollāsa composed by śrī sarvānandanātha.
